content:
mira: Quick quarterly OKR check-in — keeping this short. TL;DR: Core inference routing shipped, streaming edge case slipped, infra autoscaler still needs one more tuning pass. Asking owners to confirm next steps and PR/status.
bryan: Shipped: routing canary completed yesterday, validated 99p latency on staging. :tada:
alyssa: Streaming edge-case slipped — root cause is buffer flush ordering in runtime v2 when sequence < 8 tokens, causing truncated stream. Working on a fix, ETA EOD Wed. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4123
sam: PR review pinged @alyssa, I can take the first pass this afternoon. Small nit: please add a regression unit for prefix flush ordering.
jordan: Ownership clarification: who owns the autoscaler tuning? I thought it was eng-infra but Sam, can you confirm if you need product input for SLO targets?
sam: I'm the lead on autoscaler tuning. Need product to confirm target latency bands for Dedicated customers. Proposed: 95p <= 120ms, 99p <= 220ms for small batch workloads. @mira can you confirm?
mira: Confirming those targets look right for Q target. For Dedicated, add allowed burst to 1.5x during scheduled events. Also we should prioritize the buffer flush fix for streaming customers — it's user-facing.
alyssa: Noted. I'll include a small test harness and link the perf numbers in the PR description. Quick ask: can someone who owns the canary rollout add a watch for cross-region fallback test? I don't have infra perms to schedule it.
bryan: I can schedule the cross-region fallback and run the smoke once PR lands. Tagging steps in runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/canary-rollout
sam: small code snippet I added in the autoscaler config to ramp more conservatively:
```yaml
policy:
  ramp_factor: 1.2
  cooldown: 90s
  target_latency_p95: 120ms
```
sam: Will open autoscaler PR after we lock targets. @jordan can you confirm monitoring alerts we should enable so paging doesn't spike during tuning?
jordan: Suggest enabling a soft alert at 10% over baseline TPS and hard alert at 30%. Also add an action item to mute noisy traces for the first 2 hours of a rollout to avoid alert fatigue.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: routing-canary -> staging at 2026-03-18T18:30Z, owner=bryan
alyssa: Quick note about dependencies: quantization team has a perf doc that might affect rollout timing. @mira can you confirm if we want to block canary until quant team sign-off on perf regressions?
mira: Let's not block the canary. Continue with canary but gate prod rollout on the quant perf sign-off. If quant team flags regression >5% token cost, we pause.
bryan: Understood. I'll run the fallback and post results here. If nothing pops, we schedule prod roll for Fri EOD.
sam: I'll draft the autoscaler PR today and ping for review. Alyssa — once your runtime PR is green, ping me and I'll run the regression harness.
alyssa: Will do. Thanks everyone. Quick action items for follow-up:
- alyssa: fix buffer flush + add test (ETA Wed EOD)
- sam: autoscaler PR + monitoring config (ETA Thu)
- bryan: cross-region fallback smoke after runtime PR merges (ETA Thu)
- quant team: post perf sign-off (block prod if >5% regression)
mira: Thanks. I'll update the OKR doc with shipped/slipped and owner commits. Re-check here on Friday for final prod decision. :thumbsup:
